title: Body Parts and Senses
introduction: Describe body parts and the five familiar senses.
definition: Describe body parts and the five familiar senses.
rules: Say each word aloud. Look for examples in everyday life.
Practise the sentences with a partner.

vocabulary.description: Joins the head to the body.
Joins the arm to the upper body.
Joins the hand to the arm.
The short thick digit of the hand.
The front of the upper body.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: I see the rainbow with my eyes.
examples.answer: I see the rainbow with my eyes.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: I hear the bell with my ears.
examples.answer: I hear the bell with my ears.

exercises.question: Which joint bends in the arm?
exercises.solution: The elbow connects the upper arm and forearm.

exercises.question: Which joint is above the foot?
exercises.solution: The ankle connects the lower leg and foot.

exercises.question: Which sense helps us hear music?
exercises.solution: We use our ears to detect sounds.

exercises.question: Which sense helps us see colours?
exercises.solution: Our eyes allow us to see light and colours.

exercises.question: Which sense helps us feel a soft blanket?
exercises.solution: Our skin detects textures and pressure.

exercises.question: Which sense helps us detect a sweet flavour?
exercises.solution: Our tongue helps us detect flavours.

exercises.question: What joins the head to the body?
exercises.solution: The neck supports the head and connects it to the body.

exercises.question: What is the short thick digit on the hand?
exercises.solution: The thumb is the short digit opposite the fingers.

exercises.question: What is the front of the head?
exercises.solution: The face contains the eyes, nose and mouth.

exercises.question: What is a digit on the foot called?
exercises.solution: The digits at the end of a foot are called toes.

summary: Describe body parts and the five familiar senses.
